# Full command-surface script for pc_cli.py
# Intended for real hardware (COM port). Adjust wait times if needed.

# Reset the MCU so the script starts from a known state.
reset
wait 5

conn
wait 0.5
leds
wait 0.5
lcd
wait 0.5
log
wait 0.5
trace
wait 0.5

# Normal operation paths
cal
wait 2
meas
wait 10

# Manual / hardware mode
manual-on
wait 1
manual-on
wait 1
hal-init
wait 5

# LEDs: set/get/toggle
hal-led-set 0 1
wait 0.15
hal-led-get 0
wait 0.15
hal-led-toggle 0
wait 0.15
hal-led-get 0
wait 0.15

# Gain
hal-gain-set 0
wait 0.15
hal-gain-get
wait 0.15
hal-gain-set 3
wait 0.15
hal-gain-get
wait 0.15

# ADC
hal-adc-raw
wait 0.15
hal-adc-read
wait 0.15

# DAC tuning
hal-dac-set 0 1.23
wait 0.2
hal-dac-set 1 2.34
wait 0.2

# PWM excitation
hal-pwm-freq 20000000
wait 0.15
hal-pwm-duty 50
wait 0.15
hal-pwm-start
wait 0.2
hal-pwm-get
wait 0.2
hal-pwm-stop
wait 0.2

# NINA controls
hal-nina-rst 0
wait 0.2
hal-nina-rst 1
wait 0.2
hal-nina-stop 1
wait 0.2
hal-nina-stop 0
wait 0.2

# Button read
hal-btn-read
wait 0.2

# LCD write (pushes DAT:LCD update)
hal-lcd-set 0 HELLO
wait 1
hal-lcd-set 1 WORLD
wait 1

manual-off
wait 1
